development area: Digital discovery and data platform navigation
description: Ability to use enterprise digital platforms to systematically discover/catalogue data, evaluate metadata, and identify alternative sources.
historic work: 1. DECISION MAKING - Reviews data collection and information systems to determine the usefulness of the existing data sources, to propose changes to the system and to assess the feasibility and impact of new or modified statistical programs.
change to work: Update from subjective/expert-driven review to systematic digital discovery using agency-wide data platforms, with decisions grounded in formal cost-benefit, risk, and automation/reuse criteria. Requirement to document findings and justification for decision-making.
